name: Himehagi Sakumi
source:
Like Souichi, Sakumi was abducted coming home from school and was suddenly dragged into the game.

Good at studying but has no confidence when it comes to her own physical strength.
Lacks the spirit to go and do something by herself.
Always timid and follows someone else's lead; the type who is easily swayed by the situation.
But deep down, she hopes to change herself.

"Someone like you needs to survive. If you kill me, you can go home."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=614865]Getchu[/url]]
